original_sidecar.prompt:
REFERENCES (attached, in this order):
1. The home island: copy ONLY its camera, its plate proportions (shallow top, rounded banded body) and its soft painting. Do not copy its lawn, its colors, its round door or its pebbles.
2. The small island plate: the Koke island is this size in the frame (a small plate, narrower than home). Copy the size and the earth body's proportions only.
3. A finished station of the game: every prop on Koke's island is at this scale and in this finish (do not draw this stall).
4. The sea of clouds below every island: paint the clouds like this.

A game plate for a cozy mobile game: Koke, a small island where a big
mossy creature sleeps, in the game, on a still overcast-bright
noon. STAGE 0, STUCK. The island is a floating diorama plate with a
shallow top about a fifth as deep as it is wide, over a soft rounded
earth body with gentle bands, a small plate: about 62 percent of the
image width, centered. The top is a low rounded lawn of moss and
short grass. At the back centre sleeps Koke: a huge round mound of
moss about as tall as a windmill, like a plump hill, its soft fur
made of moss. It has a round sleepy face low on the near side, a
small blunt snout, two tiny round ears, eyes gently closed with
soft lids, the corners of its mouth slightly down, and four stubby
legs tucked under its belly, one front paw curled in front of it.
STUCK STATE: the whole creature and the whole island are faded and
grey: the moss is a dull grey-sage, like a dusty blanket, chroma
about 40 percent of a healthy meadow, under a flat cool light with
soft cool shadows and no warm light anywhere. Around it, five small
clusters of flowers stand tightly closed, each a ring of
shut grey-lilac and grey-blue buds with drooping leaves. A few
rounded mossy boulders, a path of four stepping stones from the
front lip to Koke's side, two soft ferns, and a small wooden rake
leaning on a boulder. ONE SIGN OF LIFE only: on the crown of the
hump a single tiny bright fresh-green sprout of two leaves, the
only vivid colour in the picture. The mood is quiet and sad, but it
is a sleeping creature, not a dead one: gentle, never eerie.
GAME CAMERA (this is how the island looks inside the game): exactly
the camera of the attached home island, a low front three-quarter
view about 20 degrees above the horizon, a pale sky with soft far
clouds above and the sea of clouds below rising to the island's
underside. Every prop is at the scale of the attached tea stall.
No characters other than Koke.

STYLE: soft painterly 2D illustration from the same picture book as the
attached hamster: the same gentle airbrushed shading, the same light,
high-key values and the same milky pastel colors. Simple, rounded, chunky
shapes with few parts; fewer, larger shapes, because this is seen small on
a phone. Every material is painted matte, as a soft form with broad,
smooth value changes: wood without grain, metal without hammering or
reflections, glass as a soft tinted shape, cloth without weave. At most
one small, soft highlight per object; no glints, no shine. Colors are
muted and lifted toward cream; the darkest shadow is a warm mid-brown,
never near black. Warm diffused key light from the upper left, a faint
warm rim light along the right edge, soft ambient shadow only where forms
touch. Clean, calm, uncluttered. No outlines, no hard edges. No text, no
letters, no numbers, no logos, no watermark, no border, no frame, no
sticker outline.

AVOID: scary or hollow eyes, teeth, claws, a skull, bones, rot, ruins, fog walls, gloom, darkness, a sad crying face, a pointed or spiky underside, a drop or anything falling off the island, a copy of the home island's green lawn and round door, a whale shape, text, letters, zzz, a border, harsh shadows, outlines, photorealism, a 3D render look

LIGHT (hour: day, layer: subject). Bright, clear, toy-like.
Key light #FFF6EC from the upper left; fill #BFD6EE; rim #FFE9C9 along the edge facing away from the key. Shadows are tinted #A99BC4 (never grey or black) and fall toward the lower right; paint a contact shadow in that hue under every object that touches the ground or another form, firmest in the subject plane.
VALUES: haze is depth, not a filter over the whole frame. The subject plane uses the full value range: true darks in the deepest recesses (eyes, door, soil, gaps between forms) and clean highlights. Contrast falls only with distance from the subject. A soft, gentle look means soft local colour and soft edges, never lifted blacks, a milky veil or a grey-white wash.
This is the SUBJECT plane: no atmosphere at all, the strongest contrast and the deepest darks in the picture.

Output: one image, opaque, full bleed, landscape 1536 x 1024.
